evidence: Homepage job cards show title (e.g. "Senior Frontend Developer"), location ("San Francisco, CA"), salary range ("$140k - $180k"), plus company, industry, type, date, and skill tags for all 8 listings.
Filtering by Industry=Technology reduced 8→2 jobs (job-1, job-7); filtering by Location=Boston, MA showed only job-8. Job Type filter also present with options.
Typing "React" in search box filtered results to 1 job (Senior Frontend Developer) which has React as a listed skill.
Job list count and displayed results updated immediately after selecting Industry/Location filters and typing search keyword, without page reload.
Homepage lists all 8 job openings by default ("Showing 8 jobs") with browsable cards linking to job detail pages.
Job detail page for job-1 shows title, company, location, salary, full description, responsibilities, requirements, and a "Required Skills" section listing React, TypeScript, CSS, Node.js.

Job detail page has an application form with Full Name, Email, Phone, and Cover Letter/Message fields plus a Submit Application button; submission succeeded with confirmation toast "Application submitted!"

Submitting a valid application immediately produced a success toast "Application submitted! Your application for Senior Frontend Developer at TechCorp Solutions has been sent." and the form fields cleared, with no error.

Submitting the form empty was blocked by required-field validation ("Please fill out this field."). Submitting with an invalid email ("not-an-email") was blocked by email format validation ("Please include an '@' in the email address").

actual: Submitted a second application to the same job (job-1) using the identical email (test.applicant@example.com) and name as a prior successful submission. The system accepted it and displayed the same success toast "Application submitted!" again with no warning or rejection of the duplicate.

evidence: Clicking "Post Job" with all required fields empty did not submit the form; required-field validation blocked it with "Please fill out this field." notification on Job Title (and other required fields carry the same required attribute), and no job was created.

Filled Post a Job form (title, industry, employment type, location, min/max salary, description, skill "Selenium") and clicked Post Job. Received toast "Job posted successfully! Your job listing is now live and visible to job seekers." and was redirected to dashboard where "QA Automation Engineer" now appears in Your Job Listings.

Employer Dashboard "Your Job Listings" section lists all 6 jobs posted by this employer (TechCorp Solutions/Sarah Chen), including the newly created QA Automation Engineer, each showing title, location, salary, and applicant count.

Clicking the applications count (4) on "Senior Frontend Developer" expanded an "Applications (4)" list showing all submitted applications for that job, including the two test applications just submitted plus pre-existing ones from Alex Johnson and Maria Garcia.

Each application entry clearly shows distinct applicant name (Test Applicant, Alex Johnson, Maria Garcia), email, phone (when provided), submission date, and message, making each job seeker clearly distinguishable.

issue: No edit functionality for job listings
actual: Delete works correctly (confirmed via alertdialog "Delete this job?" then job count dropped 6→5 and listing removed). However, each job row on the Employer Dashboard only exposes two controls: an applications-count toggle and a delete (trash) button. There is no edit button, link, or menu option anywhere on the dashboard or job cards to modify an existing job's details.

issue: No access control preventing job seekers from posting jobs
actual: The application has no login/authentication or role separation at all (no sign-in/login links found anywhere). The "Post a Job" nav link and /employer/post-job page are directly accessible to any visitor without any employer verification, so a job seeker can freely create job postings just like an employer.
